title: REST Upstream Semantic Adjudications
description: Field/pointer-level semantic facts settled by human adjudication (design: .claude/plans/2026-11-23-rest-adjudication-decision-ledger-design.md; 2026-11-25 review). Operation-level classification stays in the ledger; this file records what the upstream IS at field granularity so later refresh rounds stop re-asking the same question. Append-only: new rounds append or supersede by reviewed PR, never rewrite.

scope.description: Request-shape facts only. Response-scope diff entries are addressed by HTTP status code (their diff field is the status, which the fieldPath grammar cannot name) and operation-scope entries carry no field at all; the canonical key deliberately omits responseStatus, so response facts would over-match across statuses.

fieldPath.description: Dot path of the adjudicated leaf relative to the operation schema, first segment = the diff entry's top-level field (parameter scope: the bare parameter name). Required: this file never records operation-level verdicts — the ledger owns those.

fact.description: One verifiable assertion citing machine-checkable evidence: a literal set {…} or a Go symbol. The loader enforces this floor beyond the schema.

branch.description: Scenario-tab label when the adjudicated subtree lives inside one branch; absent = unbranched, and matching requires the drift entry to be unbranched too.

decision.description: upstream-truth = code/wire-verified upstream behavior the docs must align to; spec-divergence = the upstream spec and the deployed wire disagree and the wire wins.

specLiterals.description: Literals the upstream payload must still contain for the fact to count as confirmed this round; when the matched drift entry carries upstream bytes and any literal is missing, the adjudication degrades to stale and the question re-opens. Absent = the cheap staleness check cannot run and the entry stays applicable (the decide report and the refresh PR body still carry decidedAt plus the evidence PR per key).
